evidence.detail: R22 fixes rs/gui/b as RuneLiteSkin. Its constructor creates exactly one rs/gui/c instance and assigns it directly to the SubstanceSkin buttonShaper field.
The class extends Substance ClassicButtonShaper and overrides only getCornerRadius(AbstractButton,float), always returning 0.0f.
Returning zero corner radius makes the R22 RuneLiteSkin family's Substance buttons square-cornered; the class owns no unrelated look-and-feel or widget behavior.

R177 separately owns rs/ui/c/b as RuneLiteSquareButtonShaper under RuneLiteSubstanceSkin. The R463 name is therefore qualified by its exact R22 parent family rather than reusing the R177 semantic name.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the zero-corner-radius button shaper owned by R22 RuneLiteSkin. It is distinct from R177's rs/ui/c/b RuneLiteSquareButtonShaper.
